metaDescription: Scrape immobilienscout24.de: all property types, radius and map searches, price, €/m², address, coordinates, fees and agent. Monitoring mode.
intro: Paste immobilienscout24.de searches (every property type including commercial, radius and map searches) and get the numeric price, €/m², address, coordinates, purchase fees and agent. Monitoring mode reports new listings, price cuts and removed listings.

Get alerts for new listings that match a search

faq.q: Is there an official ImmoScout24 API?
faq.a: ImmoScout24's APIs are for registered partners and agents. This actor reads public search results, so you only need a search link.
